children: Singapore, September 11, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today upgraded Piramal Finance Limited's long-term corporate family rating and foreign-currency senior secured debt rating to Ba2 from Ba3. We have also upgraded the company's local-currency and FC senior secured medium-term note program rating to Ba2 from Ba3. At the same time, we have changed PFL's rating outlook, where applicable, to stable from positive.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades Piramal Finance's rating to Ba2 from Ba3; outlook stable
